emotional_tone: Objective, rigid, functional, high clarity. The aesthetic emphasizes 'Color is Function Only' — 95% of the UI is monochrome, with color serving only to guide action or warn.

spacing_and_layout.container: Use wide padding around the main content wrapper (p-6 md:p-8 lg:p-12).
spacing_and_layout.grid: Base grid for dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6.
spacing_and_layout.radii: Sharp edges. Max border radius is 4px (rounded-sm) for a technical, precise feel. No soft rounded corners.

buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-[#D1D1D1] text-[#1A1A1A] hover:bg-[#F2F2F0] rounded-sm transition-colors

data_table.layout: Dense F-Pattern layout. Stick headers, horizontal scrolling for overflow.
data_table.styles: Zebra striping with extremely subtle grey (#F9F9F8 vs #FFFFFF). Right-align numeric columns.
data_table.actions: Inline actions on row hover. Sticky right column for actions if columns exceed viewport.

forms.inputs: bg-white border border-[#D1D1D1] rounded-sm focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0033CC] focus:border-[#0033CC]
forms.labels: Use the overline typography style (uppercase, wide tracking) for all form labels.

navigation.header: Sticky top header with glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, border-b border-[#D1D1D1] z-50.

banners.friday_warning: bg-[#FFF0EA] border-l-4 border-[#FF4400] p-4 text-[#FF4400] font-medium flex items-center gap-3

icons.weight: regular or duotone depending on emphasis

motion.hover_states: Use specific transition properties: transition: background-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease
motion.micro_interactions: Subtle scale-down on active state (active:scale-95) for primary buttons.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes using kebab-case, role-based naming (e.g., admin-login-button, approve-timesheet-btn).

login_background.description: Abstract, minimalist architectural pattern for the split-screen login background, providing a high-end corporate feel without distraction.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the UI using raw Tailwind classes and Shadcn components customized to have sharp edges (rounded-sm) and high-contrast borders.
Do not use generic 'Inter' or 'Roboto'. Set up Cabinet Grotesk for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body in the Tailwind configuration.
The login page should be a split layout: left side is the login form, right side uses the login_background media URL.
For the Admin Dashboard, use the 'Control Room' grid with dense spacing to display pending timesheets and employee data efficiently.
Enforce the Friday deadline lock system prominently using the 'friday_warning' banner style.
